title: Homelab Overview
description: Top screen: the whole homelab at a glance. Below: workloads, storage book-keeping, GitOps, per-app metrics, and error logs.

panels.title: Application state · last 24 h
panels.description: One strip per Argo CD application. Green: healthy and synced. Yellow: healthy but out of sync. Red: unhealthy.

panels.title: Longhorn pool
panels.description: Space actually used on the Longhorn disk.

panels.title: Error log lines · per 5 min

targets.expr: (error OR fatal OR panic) | stats by (kubernetes.pod_namespace) count() errors

panels.description: Lines matching error, fatal, or panic, by namespace. Hover for the breakdown; the Logs row has the lines.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(12, max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes)))

panels.title: Time since last backup

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(12, ((time() - longhorn_volume_last_backup_at) and (longhorn_volume_last_backup_at > 0)) and on (pvc, pvc_namespace) label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_recurring_job_group_longhorn_io_backup="enabled"}, "pvc", "$1", "persistentvolumeclaim", "(.*)"), "pvc_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)")))

panels.description: Volumes opted in to daily backups. Yellow after 36 h, red after 72 h.

panels.title: Backup calendar · one cell per volume per day
panels.description: Volumes opted in to the daily backup job. A cell is green when a backup of that volume completed during that day.

panels.title: Storage ledger

targets.expr: max by (volume) (label_replace((100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (volumename) kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info, "volume", "$1", "volumename", "(.*)"))

panels.description: Every Longhorn volume: what was asked for, what it really occupies, how much of that is snapshot history, how full the filesystem inside is, whether it is opted in to the daily backup, and when it was last backed up.

panels.title: Snapshot history per volume

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (pvc) (longhorn_snapshot_actual_size_bytes * on (volume) group_left (pvc) group by (volume, pvc) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes))))

panels.description: Space held by snapshot chains. Reclaimed when old snapshots are purged.
